name: 33573 · Sun City Ctr, FL
findings: ZIP 33573 (Sun City Ctr) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33573 (Sun City Ctr) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
